cues.label: Chicago street 1861 seen from high on the facade: wind past the cornice, a distant bustle of carts, hooves and voices far below, a lake gull
the rich man leans out of the window above the street: cloth and wood creak, his mocking voice-over (narration) carries the quote
framing B (plan 26.0 s): push in on him, then the crane descends
crane down the brick facade: a soft airy whoosh falling away, street sounds rising as the camera nears the ground
cut to the nickname crowd shot: the street murmur turns into a crowd
crowd of townsfolk laughing and jeering in the street, boots on planks, a horse, a cart far off
Pullman's boots on the plank walk and the iron jack clanking on his shoulder as he strolls past, townsfolk giggling and pointing
the nickname lands (29.73 s, g 895): the whole crowd bursts into one big roaring laugh and cheers, feet stamping on the planks
